readOnly: Team channels are managed by workspace admins.

envFallback.title: Using the deployment's default group bots
envFallback.body: This workspace has no channels of its own yet, so notifications go to the bots your Nexus operator configured for the whole deployment. Connect a channel below to send to your own group instead.

dingtalk.name: DingTalk
dingtalk.body: Post to a DingTalk group robot (自定义机器人). Add a 加签 secret so DingTalk can verify each message.
dingtalk.urlHint: Copy the robot's webhook from the group settings: https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send?access_token=…

feishu.name: Feishu / Lark
feishu.body: Post to a Feishu or Lark custom bot. Turn on signature verification (签名校验) for extra safety.

wecom.name: WeCom
wecom.body: Post to a WeCom (企业微信) group robot. WeCom robots don't support a signing secret.

savedHint: Send a test message to check the robot receives it.

remove.title: Remove the {{channel}} channel?
remove.body: Notifications will stop posting to this group. The webhook URL and secret are deleted and can't be recovered.

form.urlKeep: Currently {{hint}}. Leave blank to keep it.
form.urlInvalid: Use the robot's https webhook on {{host}}.
form.secretHint: Optional. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.secretKeep: A secret is stored. Enter a new one to replace it.
form.label: Name
form.kindsInvalid: Pick at least one type, or choose All notifications.
